title: Titanium Dosing Pump Impeller
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for this pump application prioritizing formability and corrosion resistance over strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, its natural TiO2 passivation provides immunity to pitting in chlorides up to 260C. This rationale is driven by chemical dosing pump impeller (grade 5) and service environment demands.
process: CNC machining from plate for pump geometry
TIG welding all-position at 200W fiber laser
Passivation DI rinse at 200W fiber laser
surfaceTreatment: Pickling HF-HNO3 bath + passivation to restore passive film integrity on welded/seamed process surfaces — tailored for chemical dosing pump application
commonFailures: Weld zone preferential attack in chlorinated water - controlled by post-weld pickling and proper filler selection — critical for chemical dosing pump performance

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Dosing Pump Impeller suitable for Chemical dosing pump impeller (Grade 5)?
faq.a: Titanium Dosing Pump Impeller uses Grade 2 CP-Ti because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address pump operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Dosing Pump Impeller?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Dosing Pump Impeller is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for chemical dosing pump requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Dosing Pump Impeller require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. chemical dosing pump components require Pickling HF-HNO3 bath + passivation to restore passive film integrity on welded/seamed process surfaces — tailored for chemical dosing pump application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Dosing Pump Impeller shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Dosing Pump Impeller includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet chemical dosing pump specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for Pump impeller / Dosing impeller pump components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
